query:
UPDATE positions SET
                quantity = ?,
                side = ?,
                avg_entry_price = ?,
                current_price = ?,
                market_value = ?,
                cost_basis = ?,
                unrealized_pl = ?,
                unrealized_pl_percent = ?,
                realized_pl = ?,
                updated_at = ?,
                pattern_name = ?,
                signal_confidence = ?,
                entry_orders = ?,
                exit_orders = ?
            WHERE account_id = ? AND symbol = ?
